profile: CytomX Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing oncology therapies. Its PROBODY platform uses tumor-associated proteases to conditionally activate masked biologics, including antibody-drug conjugates, T-cell engagers and cytokines. The company’s clinical programs include varsetatug masetecan, an investigational antibody-drug conjugate targeting EpCAM, and CX-801; its pipeline also includes preclinical programs.
